analysis: I-SPY 2 pCR-informed treatment-stage response model comparison
leakage_controls: One linked row per patient; the split is performed on unique participant identifiers.
No participant identifier is used as a model feature.
The pCR classifier uses T1/T2 only; T3 is not a predictor.
pCR is a training target, never an input feature.
The T3 forecast uses training patients only and does not use pCR as a predictor.
Scaling and treatment-arm encoding are fitted within each training-only pipeline.
Patient-level data and identifiers are not written to the output.
limitations: The locked holdout is internal to the 384-person feature-linked cohort, not external validation.
The test set is modest; bootstrap intervals may be wide and are conditional on this split.
The nonlinear term is exploratory; performance differences must be assessed with the paired test-set interval.
Treatment-arm adjustment is predictive, not a causal treatment-effect estimate.
HR and HER2 are used as workbook-coded fields; their detailed assay definitions are not re-derived here.
The workbook volume field's exact unit and implementation equivalence to trial FTV remain unverified.
No spatial PDE coefficient is estimated because the linked workbooks lack the required spatial/time-resolved observations.

measurement_definition.physical_unit: not asserted; workbook-specific unit remains unverified
measurement_definition.primary_measure: workbook volume field VOLUME_TUM_BLU_V1x; treated as a functional MRI enhancement-volume proxy
measurement_definition.time_handling: T1 and T2 are named visit-stage features; no day intervals or per-day rates are constructed

linear_response_reference.pcr_model: logit(P(pCR)) = intercept + linear terms in r1, r2, age, HR, HER2 and treatment-arm indicators
linear_response_reference.t3_forecast: r3 predicted by ridge regression on r1, r2, age, HR, HER2 and treatment-arm indicators

quadratic_nonlinear_response.pcr_model: linear predictor additionally includes r1^2, r1*r2 and r2^2
quadratic_nonlinear_response.t3_forecast: ridge regression additionally includes r1^2, r1*r2 and r2^2

outcome.coding_basis: Li et al., npj Breast Cancer (2020), DOI 10.1038/s41523-020-00203-7

paired_uncertainty.method: paired patient bootstrap of the locked test set

reaction_diffusion_comparator.mathematical_reason: For no-flux boundaries, integrating dC/ds = D*laplacian(C) + R over the domain gives d/ds integral(C) = integral(R), because the boundary integral of grad(C) dot n is zero. The whole-lesion volume therefore removes D from the aggregate balance; scalar pCR and morphology summaries do not restore spatial information.

split.method: stratified patient-level holdout; split performed on unique participant IDs
